events.title: Development Update – Demo Polish & Final Development Phase
events.summary: Development UpdateHello everyone,I wanted to share a quick update on the progress of HAIGLA.Over the past months, development has been moving steadily forward, and the majority of the game's core content is now complete. Most of the planned gameplay sections, environments, systems, puzzles, and encounters are already implemented and playable.My current focus is on polishing the demo experience and continuing work on the final parts of the game.
